items.heading: מבאר ההכאה והביטוש שנעשה בעת הסתלקות האורות אל המאציל בין האור החוזר היורד ובין הרשימות אשר מהניצוצין שיצאו מחמת ההכאה נתהוו הכלים שהם האותיות. ומהרשימות הן התגין, ובו ח' ענינים: — מלכות נקראת אספקלריא דלא נהרא, מחמת שלא חזר לרדת אור שלה בכלי שבה
items.html: *And know that all the nine lights, when they returned and ascended, left a record in their place, but Malchut ascended entirely and left no record whatsoever in her place. And this is the secret of what is written in the books of the Zohar and the Tikkunim, that Malchut is called “a mirror that does not shine,” having nothing of her own. And this matter has already been explained above, regarding the vessel of Malchut, 1that her light did not return to descend into the vessel that is in her, but remained in the vessel of Yesod.

items.heading: אופן שני למה שמלכות נקראת אספקלריא דלא נהרא, מחמת שלא השאירה רשימה בכלי שלה
items.html: There is also a second manner: for when her light ascended above, it left in her no record at all; but the record that remained in the vessel of Yesod for its own need was illuminating from there also in the vessel of Malchut.

items.heading: זווג דהכאה בין או"ח היורד מן יסוד אל מלכות, ובין אור א' של מלכות העולה
items.html: *And when the light of Malchut ascended to Yesod, Yesod was illuminating 2in the vessel of Malchut through the posterior of Yesod itself, as above, in the secret of reflected light. And then the reflected light that descends into the vessel of Malchut 3meets Malchut’s own first light that ascends upward, and this clashes with that, 4and sparks descended from the descending reflected light 5into the vessel of Malchut.

items.heading: כלי היסוד נעשה מן הניצוצין שנפלו מהכאת האור הבא דרך אחוריו ברשימה. והתגין נעשו מהרשימה המאירה מרחוק
items.html: And when Yesod ascended it left a record in its place, and when the light came to it through its posterior it struck at this record, and sparks fell from it, 6and from them the phase of the vessel of Yesod was made. And then that record was illuminating in this vessel from afar, and did not enter within it, 7and this is the secret of the Tagin [crownlets].

items.heading: ג' הבחנות בעשר הספירות: כתר. ושאר הספירות. ומלכות. כתר הניח רשימה ולא כלי. שאר הספירות הניחו רשימות וכלים. ומלכות הניחה כלי ולא רשימה
items.html: And so did all the Sefirot do, 8except for Keter, which left the record for the need of Hochma 9but did not make the phase of a vessel. For granted, in the rest of the Sefirot, in their ascent above, by means of 10striking against what is above them 20and the striking of the record, 30the phase of the vessels was made; but 40for Keter there is none who strikes at its record in its ascent, and therefore its vessel was not yet completed. Thus Keter [crown] left a record and not a vessel; the rest of the Sefirot left a record and a vessel; and Malchut left a vessel and not a record.

items.heading: אחר כל ההסתלקות חזרו האורות למקומם, דהיינו בפרצוף ע"ב דא"ק, חוץ מאור הכתר, ואז נעשה ביטוש מרשימה דכתר ואור החכמה זה בזה ויצאו ב' כלים, א' לכתר וא' לחכמה, שה"ס זכר ונקבה בראש ע"ב דא"ק.
items.html: 50Indeed, after these Sefirot received from the Emanator they returned to their place 60except for Keter, as above. And then 70the vessel of Keter was made only upon the return, for when Hochma returned and entered into it, then 80the light of Hochma struck at the record that Keter left in it in its place. 90And these strikings were double: for since the record of Keter, being a phase higher than Hochma, therefore it strikes at Hochma and brings forth sparks; and also Hochma, since it now comes from above and is found standing over the record, being higher than it, therefore it now struck at the record and brought forth other sparks. Therefore two vessels were now made, 100one for the record of Keter and one for the Hochma that came now. And we have already 200expounded at length on this elsewhere, how there is a male and a Nukva in Keter, and they are these two that we have mentioned here, which are the record and the Hochma.

items.heading: ההזדככות וההסתלקות שהיו בעקודים דומות בצד מה לביטול מלכים של עולם הנקודים שמתו ונתבטלו
items.html: And now from here you will be able to understand how there is also in the world of Akudim a reality of the nullification of the kings in a certain respect, in the likeness of those kings who reigned in the land of Edom, who died and were nullified, as mentioned in the discourse on the world of Nekudim. For indeed the matter of 300the concealment of the lights of Akudim and their ascent into their Emanator is likewise a nullification of the kings here; examine closely and you will find.

items.heading: ההפרש ביניהם שכאן היה קלקול ע"מ לתקן, ובנקודים היתה שבירה ומיתה ממש
items.html: Indeed, the difference between them is this: that here in Akudim 400the corruption was in order to correct, and the demolishing in order to build, for this was the principal intention — to ascend in order to make the phases of the vessels. But in Nekudim there was an actual and complete nullification and death. And indeed, since from Akudim the vessels began to be revealed somewhat, therefore here too there was some nullification.
